title: Free open-source Kraken paper/live trading bot (Python + CCXT)
author: ConfidentRepair8245
selftext:
I built a free, open-source trading bot for Kraken that supports both paper trading and live trading.



Key features:

• Completely free and open source

• Stop-loss ratcheting (moves stop to entry to protect capital)

• Paper simulation mode built in

• Works with Kraken Pro via CCXT



Repo: [https://github.com/LucasMurr369/nikola-job](https://github.com/LucasMurr369/nikola-job)



Feel free to fork, use, or ask questions.
